short.zh: 区分一个数字是由理论公式算出（formula）、本机 CPU 真实运行测得（cpu_measured），还是由硬件模拟器推演得出（simulated）。
short.en: Marks whether a number comes from a theoretical equation (formula), real local CPU timing (cpu_measured), or an architectural model (simulated).

analogy.zh: 就像看地图导航：纸面路程除以限速是“公式估算”，自己骑车掐表是“本机实测”，沙盘推演高速路况是“架构模拟”——绝不能把骑车时间当成高铁速度。
analogy.en: Like trip planning: distance divided by speed limit is a formula, timing a bike ride is a local measurement, and modeling traffic on a highway is a simulation — never confuse bike time with bullet-train speed.

short.zh: 自动对比程序“实际输出”与“预期结果”是否一致的验证守门员。
short.en: An automated check that compares your program's actual output against the expected result.

analogy.zh: 就像自动售货机的硬币检测口：尺寸和重量对得上就放行，对不上就立即退回并告诉你差了多少。
analogy.en: Like a coin slot on a vending machine: if diameter and weight match, it passes; otherwise it rejects immediately and tells you the mismatch.

short.zh: 用 a[start:stop] 截取左闭右开的连续片段，并用循环将每一步的结果汇总到一个累加变量中。
short.en: Using a[start:stop] to extract a half-open contiguous range and a loop to accumulate per-item results into a running total.

analogy.zh: 就像在货架第 2 格到第 5 格之间依次取货，每拿一件都在记账本上加上它的价格。
analogy.en: Like walking from shelf slot 2 up to slot 5 and adding each item's price onto a running tally.

short.zh: 描述二维表格有几行（第 0 轴）和几列（第 1 轴）的尺寸元组，例如 (1024, 512) 表示 1024 行、512 列。
short.en: A pair (rows, cols) describing how many rows (axis 0) and columns (axis 1) a 2D table has, e.g. (1024, 512).

analogy.zh: 就像电影院座位表：(排数, 每排座位数) 一眼就能算出全场总共能坐多少人。
analogy.en: Like a theater seating chart: (number of rows, seats per row) immediately tells you layout and total seats.

short.zh: 每个数字占用的固定字节数（如 float32 占 4B，float16/bfloat16 占 2B），乘以元素总数即为内存体积。
short.en: Fixed byte width per number (e.g. 4B for float32, 2B for float16/bfloat16); multiplied by element count gives memory footprint.

analogy.zh: 就像快递箱规格：大号箱每只占 4 格，中号箱每只占 2 格；1000 件货乘以单箱格数就是仓库要留出的总空间。
analogy.en: Like shipping box sizes: large boxes take 4 slots, medium boxes take 2 slots; item count times box size gives warehouse space needed.

short.zh: 当形状为 (R, C) 的二维矩阵与形状为 (C,) 的一维向量相加时，NumPy 自动将该向量沿每一行虚拟对齐相加，无需复制整张矩阵。
short.en: When a (R, C) 2D matrix meets a (C,) 1D vector, NumPy virtually aligns and applies the vector across every row without copying memory.

analogy.zh: 就像全班成绩表每科统一加平时分：只需写一行“各科加分标准”，不必把这张标准复印几十份贴给每个人。
analogy.en: Like adding a per-subject bonus across a grade sheet: you write one bonus row at the top instead of photocopying it for every student.

short.zh: 把逐元素的 Python 循环交给底层编译好的连续内存批处理算子执行，消除每次循环的解释器调度开销。
short.en: Replacing element-by-element Python loops with compiled batch array operations over contiguous memory, eliminating interpreter overhead.

analogy.zh: Python 循环像一次只搬一块砖还要每次签字登记；向量化像直接开叉车整托盘搬运，只签一次单。
analogy.en: A Python loop carries one brick at a time and signs a form each trip; vectorization moves the whole pallet on a forklift with one dispatch.

short.zh: 用二进制科学计数法表示实数：符号位决定正负，指数位（Exponent）决定能表示多大/多小的范围，尾数位（Mantissa）决定有效数字精度。
short.en: Binary scientific notation: 1 sign bit sets +/-, exponent bits set dynamic range (how large/small), and mantissa bits set precision.

analogy.zh: 就像科学计数法 +1.25 × 10^8：指数决定了后面跟几个零（量级跨度），尾数决定了小数点后能写几位细节。
analogy.en: Like +1.25 × 10^8: the exponent controls how many zeros follow (scale), while the mantissa controls how many digits of detail you keep.

short.zh: 两者都占 16 位（2 字节）：FP16 用 5 位指数 + 10 位尾数（最大仅 65504，易溢出）；BF16 用 8 位指数 + 7 位尾数（范围与 FP32 几乎一致，不易爆成 Inf）。
short.en: Both use 16 bits (2B): FP16 has 5 exp + 10 mantissa bits (max 65504, overflows easily); BF16 has 8 exp + 7 mantissa bits (FP32-like range, resists Inf overflow).

analogy.zh: 同样 16 格预算：FP16 选了“放大镜”（看细节清楚但视野窄，超过 65504 就爆表），BF16 选了“广角镜”（颗粒粗一点但装得下整座大山）。
analogy.en: With the same 16-bit budget, FP16 buys a magnifying glass (sharp detail, narrow range up to 65504), while BF16 buys a wide-angle lens (coarser grain, fits huge numbers).

short.zh: 当大数与远小于其尾数最小刻度的小数直接相加时，小数在对阶舍入中被完全丢弃（如 float32 下 1e8 + 1.0 仍等于 1e8）；先将小数分块累加可显著缓解。
short.en: Adding a tiny number directly to a huge float drops the tiny value during exponent alignment (e.g. float32(1e8) + 1.0 == 1e8); summing small values in chunks first prevents loss.

analogy.zh: 就像用只显示“吨”的卡车地磅称重：往 100 吨卡车上每次放 1 块苹果，读数纹丝不动；先把一万个苹果装成一整箱再上秤，重量才会被看见。
analogy.en: Like a truck scale that only reads whole tons: tossing one apple onto a 100-ton truck never moves the dial, unless you crate thousands of apples together first.

short.zh: FLOPs 是浮点加减乘除的“总次数”（工作量，一次乘加计 2 FLOPs）；FLOP/s（如 GFLOP/s = 10^9 FLOP/s）是每秒完成的浮点运算速率。
short.en: FLOPs is the total count of floating-point operations (work volume; 1 multiply + 1 add = 2 FLOPs); GFLOP/s (10^9 FLOP/s) is the compute rate per second.

analogy.zh: FLOPs 就像“一共要跑 10 公里”（路程总量），GFLOP/s 就像“时速 20 公里/小时”（奔跑速度）——算账时绝不能混为一谈。
analogy.en: FLOPs is distance ('run 10 km total'), while GFLOP/s is speed ('20 km per hour') — never mix up total work with rate.

short.zh: CPU 用一条向量指令在宽寄存器（如 256 位 AVX2 可装 8 个 float32）上同时对多个数字做同一种运算。
short.en: A CPU mechanism where a single instruction operates on multiple numbers packed into a wide vector register (e.g. 8 float32s in 256-bit AVX2) at once.

analogy.zh: 就像一排带 8 个印章头的联排印章：盖一下就同时印好 8 张票，而不是拿单枚印章连敲 8 下。
analogy.en: Like an 8-head rubber stamp bar that stamps 8 tickets in one press instead of stamping one ticket 8 separate times.

title.zh: 缓存行（Cache Line）与空间局部性

short.zh: CPU 从主存拿数据时不是只取 4 字节，而是以固定大小的缓存行（常见 64 字节 = 16 个 float32）为单位整条搬运；紧挨着读取就能白嫖同行的其余 15 个元素。
short.en: CPUs fetch memory in fixed-size cache lines (typically 64 bytes = 16 float32s); reading adjacent elements reuses all 16 numbers from one fetch.

analogy.zh: 就像鸡蛋只能整托（16 枚一托）从冷库搬到灶台：顺着吃能吃完一整托；如果每托只拿 1 枚就扔掉其余 15 枚，搬运工就会累死在路上。
analogy.en: Like fetching eggs from storage in 16-egg cartons: cooking sequentially uses all 16 eggs per trip, whereas taking 1 egg per carton wastes 15/16 of your carrying capacity.

title.zh: 访问步长（Stride）与零拷贝视图（View）

short.zh: 步长是相邻两次访问在内存中跨越的距离；NumPy 基础切片（如 a[::16] 或 mat[:, j]）只改步长元数据而不拷贝底层数组（np.shares_memory 为 True）。
short.en: Stride is the byte/element jump between consecutive accesses; NumPy basic slicing (e.g. a[::16], mat[:, j]) creates a zero-copy view sharing the original buffer.

analogy.zh: 视图切片就像给同一本书套上一张镂空阅读卡：书一个字都没重印（零拷贝），只是阅读卡决定了你是顺着逐字读（按行）还是跳着读（按列）。
analogy.en: A slice view is like laying a stencil over a book: zero pages are reprinted, yet the stencil controls whether you read adjacent words or jump across lines.

short.zh: 若程序中不可并行的串行比例为 s，使用 P 个处理器时的理论最高加速比为 1 / (s + (1 - s) / P)；即使 P 趋于无穷大，加速比也无法超过 1 / s。
short.en: If fraction s of a program is serial, maximum speedup on P workers is 1 / (s + (1 - s) / P); even with infinite cores, speedup is capped at 1 / s.

analogy.zh: 就像做一桌菜：切菜（占 80% 时间）可以找 4 个帮厨平分，但最后大火收汁（占 20% 时间）只能一口锅串行完成，总时间永远不可能压到收汁时间以下。
analogy.en: Like cooking a banquet: 4 chefs can split chopping (80% of time), but simmering in one pot (20%) stays serial — total time can never beat that serial step.

short.zh: 启动多个独立操作系统进程同时在不同 CPU 核心上处理互不依赖的子任务，但伴随进程启动与跨进程传参（序列化）开销。
short.en: Running independent OS processes across multiple CPU cores in parallel, trading off parallel compute gains against process startup and IPC serialization overhead.

analogy.zh: 就像把一摞考卷分给 4 个办公室的老师同时批改：卷子够厚时能快好几倍；如果只有 2 道口算题，跑腿发卷收卷的时间反而比自己算还慢。
analogy.en: Like distributing exam stacks to 4 rooms of graders: great for thick stacks, but if there are only 2 tiny questions, walking down the hall takes longer than grading alone.

short.zh: 一个算子执行的浮点运算总次数除以它从主存读写的数据总字节数（FLOPs / Bytes），衡量“每搬运 1 字节数据能做多少次计算”。
short.en: Total floating-point operations divided by total bytes transferred to/from memory (FLOPs / Bytes) — how much math you do per byte moved.

analogy.zh: 就像食材深加工度：洗个黄瓜生吃（向量加法）是“搬一斤菜只切一刀”，算术强度极低；揉面做千层酥（大矩阵乘法）是“搬一斤面反复折叠几百次”，算术强度很高。
analogy.en: Like kitchen prep intensity: rinsing cucumbers (vector add) moves heavy produce for one cut, whereas laminating puff pastry (large matmul) works each gram of dough hundreds of times.

title.zh: Roofline 屋顶线模型与拐点

short.zh: 将算子理论最高性能表示为 min(峰值算力, 算术强度 × 内存带宽) 的屋顶折线；斜坡与平顶交汇处的算术强度（峰值算力 / 峰值带宽）称为拐点（Ridge Point），左侧为访存受限（memory-bound），右侧为算力受限（compute-bound）。
short.en: Bounds attainable performance by min(Peak Compute, AI × Peak Bandwidth); the Ridge Point (Peak Compute / Peak Bandwidth) separates memory-bound (left slope) from compute-bound (right flat roof).

analogy.zh: 就像工厂产能受限于 min(机器加工上限, 传送带供料速度 × 每公斤原料加工道数)：供料跟不上时加再多机器也闲着（访存受限）；原料很耐加工时机器才满载轰鸣（算力受限）。
analogy.en: Like factory output capped by min(machine speed, conveyor belt speed × work per kg): if the belt starves machines you are memory-bound; if each item gets heavy processing you hit the compute ceiling.

short.zh: 一个指令作用于多条各有寄存器的线程。
short.en: One issued instruction serves threads with individual registers.

analogy.zh: 同一道加法，每位学生拿自己的数。
analogy.en: Each student adds a different pair on the same cue.

short.zh: 本模型中共同发射指令的 32 个通道。
short.en: A group of 32 lanes issued together in this model.

analogy.zh: 同一排座位，每个座位有自己的编号。
analogy.en: One row of seats with individually numbered positions.

short.zh: 不同通道走不同分支时，部分通道在另一条路径执行期间等待。
short.en: Lanes taking different branches may wait while another path executes.

analogy.zh: 同一队人分两批通过不同入口。
analogy.en: One group takes turns passing through different doors.

short.zh: 为整卡提供大容量和高吞吐的片外存储。
short.en: High-bandwidth off-chip memory shared by the device.

analogy.zh: 可以大量进货的中央库房。
analogy.en: A central warehouse equipped for bulk deliveries.

short.zh: 由同一线程块显式读写的片上空间。
short.en: On-chip storage explicitly managed by a block.

analogy.zh: 同一工作组共用的近手工具台。
analogy.en: A nearby bench shared by one work team.

short.zh: 把相邻通道的地址归并到少量对齐事务。
short.en: Serve neighboring lane addresses with fewer aligned transactions.

analogy.zh: 同一路段的多个订单合在一趟车上。
analogy.en: One delivery trip covers several adjacent addresses.

short.zh: 同一指令向一个 Bank 索取多个不同字时需要多轮。
short.en: Several distinct words requested from one bank require successive rounds.

analogy.zh: 一个窗口依次处理不同的申请。
analogy.en: One counter serves distinct requests in turn.

short.zh: 一次装入一小片数据，在片上完成多次运算。
short.en: Stage a small region once and reuse it across operations.

analogy.zh: 一本书摊开后同时查多个问题。
analogy.en: Consult one open book for several questions.

short.zh: 前向产生且供后续更新读取的中间张量占用的空间。
short.en: Space for intermediate tensors saved for later updates.

analogy.zh: 留下算题草稿以便回查输入。
analogy.en: Keep intermediate work to trace an earlier input.

short.zh: 用于准确累加多次小更新的高精度参数副本。
short.en: High-precision parameter copies that accumulate small updates.

analogy.zh: 账本保留比分次展示更多的小数位。
analogy.en: A ledger retains more digits than a displayed balance.

short.zh: 先放大再恢复梯度，让低精度运算保留小量。
short.en: Scale gradients up before low-precision arithmetic and unscale before updating.

analogy.zh: 先调高录音增益，再校正音量。
analogy.en: Raise recording gain then correct the playback level.

short.zh: 只保存选定边界，在反向时重跑边界之间的前向。
short.en: Save selected boundaries and replay forward segments during backward.

analogy.zh: 只留几个路标，需要时重走一小段。
analogy.en: Keep waypoints and retrace one segment when needed.

short.zh: 用当前最大值稳定地累加指数分母。
short.en: Accumulate exponentials stably using a running maximum.

analogy.zh: 更换计量单位时同时换算旧账。
analogy.en: Convert the old balance whenever the unit changes.

short.zh: 以片上分块和在线归一化减少注意力中间量的片外搬运。
short.en: Tile exact attention and normalize online to reduce off-chip transfers.

analogy.zh: 看完一页就更新总账，无须摊开整本。
analogy.en: Update a running sum after each page.

short.zh: 把每次启动和按量传输分别计时。
short.en: Account separately for per-message startup and variable transfer time.

analogy.zh: 叫车等候和按里程行驶分别耗时。
analogy.en: Waiting for a taxi and traveling the distance both take time.

short.zh: 所有参与者都收到逐元素归约后的完整结果。
short.en: All participants receive the full elementwise reduction.

analogy.zh: 每家分店拿到相同的全店销售总表。
analogy.en: Each shop gets the same chain-wide totals.

short.zh: 每个 rank 只收到总结果的一片。
short.en: Each rank receives one slice of the reduced result.

analogy.zh: 各人负责汇总表中的一段。
analogy.en: Each owner receives one part of the summary.

short.zh: 收集各 rank 的分片并按编号拼接。
short.en: Collect rank-owned shards in order.

analogy.zh: 所有人交换各自负责的章节，得到整本。
analogy.en: Exchange separately owned chapters to assemble a book.

short.zh: 把小梯度合并为一个通信单元。
short.en: Group small gradients into a single communication unit.

analogy.zh: 凑齐一箱就发车，下一箱继续装。
analogy.en: Ship each filled crate while packing the next.

short.zh: 分摊优化器、梯度或参数的持久存储，按需交换分片。
short.en: Partition persistent optimizer state, gradients or parameters and exchange shards as needed.

analogy.zh: 分工保管不同账页。
analogy.en: Different owners keep different ledger pages.

short.zh: 在多个设备间分割同一层的矩阵运算。
short.en: Split the matrix computation of a single layer across devices.

analogy.zh: 把同一张大表的列分给不同计算者。
analogy.en: Divide columns of one large table among workers.

short.zh: 因依赖未满足而空闲的级与时间格。
short.en: Idle stage-time slots caused by unsatisfied dependencies.

analogy.zh: 流水线上工位等待下一件产品。
analogy.en: A station waits for its next workpiece.
